params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch effectively reduces the cognitive complexity of the `redo_combine` method by extracting the handling of cases with one and two antecedent items into separate private methods. It replaces nested if-else statements with a switch-case, improving readability and maintainability without altering the original logic. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; all modifications are focused on fixing the cognitive complexity warning.

Score: 3
